data.exact_reserve_text: During the year there was net claims development improvement of GBP 14.7 million on the 2013 and prior years, GBP 1.9 million on the 2014 year, GBP 2.7 million on the 2015 year and an improvement of GBP 0.5 million on the 2016 year of account.
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 gross claims outstanding were GBP 231.843m. During 2017 prior year reserves showed an overall gross release of GBP 9.29m (4.0% of opening reserves). The movement reflects a mix of favourable claims development (notably on older professional indemnity primary accounts), changes in reserving following an external actuarial review and internal case reserve adjustments, and reallocation/large-loss movements between primary and excess layers. Key affected lines include Professional Lines (primary PI) and Casualty/excess layers.
raw_causal_phrases: significant deterioration seen in the claims reserves during 2015
high degree of uncertainty over the outcome of many claims due to their relative stage of development, many of which involve complex litigation over a long period
incorporation of the reserves advised by the independent claims consultants in 2015 and the internal case reserve increases in 2016 led to some distortion in the development patterns
A comprehensive review of all outstanding case reserves was conducted by the Claims team
The large loss load was therefore redistributed according to this analysis

net claims development improvement of GBP 14.7 million on the 2013 and prior years, GBP 1.9 million on the 2014 year, GBP 2.7 million on the 2015 year and an improvement of GBP 0.5 million on the 2016 year of account
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the prior-year movement were taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding) and the Technical provisions reconciliation (Changes for prior years) respectively. The reconciliation table gives gross movement (used here) but the narrative quotes net (after reinsurance) improvements by year; those net figures were NOT used for the prior_year_development_gbp_m field. LOB-specific amounts were mapped/inferred from narrative descriptions (e.g. 'primary professional indemnity'  Professional Lines, 'excess layers'  Casualty) and therefore have lower confidence. No specific named catastrophe events were identified in the text.
